name: Storm coast
one_line: Dark green waves, slate cloud and one lighthouse beam.
look_words: A rocky coast in a storm, painted in thick oil strokes. The sea is dark green-grey with white spray, the rocks are wet black-slate, the clouds are heavy with one pale break. A single warm yellow light, the lighthouse or a lantern, is the only warm colour and everything turns around it. Yellow marks safety and things to collect, sea-glass green marks the goal, orange-red is harm, and the player is pale so it shows against dark water. Shapes are big and simple so they read through rain. Motion is strong: waves heaving, spray, a sweeping beam, driving rain, a rocking boat. Avoid blue tropical water, flat calm, grey mush with no light source, and bloom on the beam.

palette.name: storm sea
palette.notes: The main "ground" is the sea. The sky light is weak and grey; the warm light should be one you place (the beam, a lantern).
